title: Lorraine Motel

orientationControl.basis: Preserved motel frontage follows the museum southwest boundary and the separate balcony polygon 35185917602225. It faces the Mulberry Street courtyard, not east toward the article point. The full museum polygon is context, not the modeled building scope.

notes: The 42.567 m long frontage follows the two map vertices at the preserved balcony edge. Angled connecting bays and the short return follow the remaining balcony polyline. Modern museum volumes behind the motel are excluded; rear closure depth is interpreted from photographs, not the entire combined museum envelope. Sign position is estimated inside the courtyard from the inspected public-domain street view; it is not a measured control.
limitations: Generalized map controls, photographic heights and interpreted rear closure; no survey dimensions.
The schematic museum donor map is excluded from current imagery approval and supplies no world coordinates.
Coarse host terrain is retained independently and reviewed for contact.
geometryLabel: Museum outline and preserved balcony; model covers courtyard-facing frontage only

axis: +X south-southwest along the long motel frontage; +Z west-northwest into the courtyard; +Y up.
